idea: Seasonal (first day of November, autumn) music clip in the BACKYARD: a big yellow leaf lands on Baby Jimmy's curls ('Oh! A leaf on my head!'); he worries as the apple tree's leaves fall down, down, down; Ava explains 'It's fall! Leaves fall down!', holds up one red and one yellow leaf and asks the viewer 'What color is this leaf?' (pause) – 'Red! And yellow!'; both wiggle their fingers down like falling leaves (copy-me). Loop: the hook framing again, now a red leaf on Ava's head too, bye-bye wave.
lesson: In the fall (autumn) leaves change color – red and yellow – and fall down from the trees; it is nothing to worry about.
calendar: Sunday slot 2 – Seasonal / holiday / special-day story (1 Nov 2026 = autumn, leaves falling)
setting: BACKYARD: a sunny backyard with soft green grass, a white fence, a wooden swing hanging on a big apple tree with red apples, a small sandbox with a blue bucket and toys, colorful flower beds, Biscuit's red doghouse with a bone sign and a ball, and the back of the pastel yellow house with the blue roof and a small patio. + SEASON: a sunny autumn day – the leaves of the big apple tree have turned red, orange and yellow, and some colorful fallen leaves lie scattered on the soft green grass.
characters: Jimmy (OUTDOOR): BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.

Ava (OUTDOOR): BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing pink overalls over a yellow t-shirt with a small flower and white sneakers with pink laces.

identity_keys.Jimmy: fluffy curly GINGER hair, big BLUE eyes, light FRECKLES, LIGHT BLUE T-SHIRT with a small YELLOW STAR, navy shorts
identity_keys.Ava: short curly BROWN hair, ONE small top PONYTAIL (pink band), sparkly PINK STAR clip, BROWN eyes, PINK OVERALLS over a YELLOW T-SHIRT

supporting: THE LEAVES: bright maple-shaped autumn leaves – one big YELLOW leaf on Jimmy's head (all shots), one RED + one YELLOW leaf in Ava's hands (shot 3), one RED leaf on Ava's head (shot 5 only).

learning.goal: In the fall, leaves change color (red, yellow) and fall down from the trees.
learning.shown_how: The apple tree is red/orange/yellow and leaves drift down in every shot; a yellow leaf lands on Jimmy's head; Ava holds exactly one RED and one YELLOW leaf beside her face; the babies wiggle their fingers down like falling leaves.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:11-0:14 Ava: 'What color is this leaf? Hmm?' + question boing → 0:14-0:16 humming pause → 0:16 answer 'Red! A red leaf! And yellow, yellow too!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: 0:19-0:23 'Wiggle your fingers, down, down, down!' – both babies wiggle spread fingers and float their hands down
learning.fact_check: Deciduous trees' leaves turn red/orange/yellow and drop in autumn ('fall' in US English) – correct. Shot 3 frame: exactly 2 leaves in Ava's hands, one red, one yellow (checked). One yellow leaf on Jimmy's head (checked).
learning.modeling: Jimmy's small worry is calmly answered by Ava (falling leaves are normal in the fall); the babies stay sitting safely on the grass; positive, curious, joyful.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, warm sunny colors, gentle falling leaves, worry lasts ~4 s and is resolved, faces large (each ≥ 1/5 frame height).

title: Oh! A Leaf on My Head! 🍂 Leaves Fall Down | Fall Song for Kids | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh! A yellow leaf just landed on Baby Jimmy's head! 🍂 The leaves are falling down, down, down – but Baby Ava knows why: it's fall! Can you tell her what color the leaves are?

🎬 What happens in this video:
🍁 A big yellow leaf lands on Jimmy's curly hair – "Oh! A leaf on my head!"
😮 "Oh no! The leaves fall down, down, down!"
🍂 Ava sings: "It's fall! Leaves fall down!"
🤔 "What color is this leaf?" – can you answer?
❤️💛 "Red! A red leaf! And yellow, yellow too!"
✋ Wiggle your fingers down like falling leaves! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: in the fall, leaves change color and fall down from the trees • the colors red and yellow • English words: leaves, fall down, red, yellow

A fun sing-along autumn cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about falling leaves and fall colors – answer the question, wiggle your fingers along and learn new English words with Jimmy and Ava!
